svg.text: SOLID SORBENT DIRECT AIR CAPTURE (S-DAC) MODULAR TVSA CONTACTOR CELL
Modular Temperature-Vacuum Swing Adsorption Architecture (ISO 10628 / Deutz & Bardow 2021 Nature Energy)
BASIS: 1,000 kg NET ATMOSPHERIC CO2 CAPTURED (CLIMEWORKS ORCA ARCHETYPE)
CAD SECTION VIEW A-A | P&ID INSTRUMENTED

g.text: Condensed Water (+2.0 t H2O / t CO2)
• Louvers OPEN; axial fans blow 1.6M m3 air/t CO2 across bed at 1.2 m/s
• Chemisorption on primary amines: ΔH_ads = -85 kJ/mol; Fan power: 140 kWh/t
• Louvers HERMETICALLY SEALED with pneumatic bladder gaskets
• Vacuum roots blowers evacuate non-adsorbed N2/O2 down to 0.15 bar (prevents oxidation)
PHASE 3: STEAM HEATING & THERMAL DESORPTION (60 - 90 min)
• Saturated 100 °C steam circulates in jacket; bed reaches 95-100 °C
• CO2 & co-adsorbed H2O desorb; vacuum pump extracts 95%+ pure CO2
• Steam cut off; bed cools to <45 °C under controlled filtered air repressurization
• Louvers unseal; ready for next adsorption cycle (Sorbent life: >5,000 cycles)
• Specific Heat Duty (95-100 °C): 5.76 - 7.50 GJ_th / t CO2 (Low-grade waste/geothermal)
• Total Electric Consumption: 400 - 650 kWh_e / t CO2 (Fans, vacuum, comp)
• Net Water Co-Production: +1.5 - 2.5 t H2O / t CO2 (High purity byproduct)
SOLID SORBENT DAC TVSA CONTACTOR CELL
AUDIT METRICS: Thermal: 5.76-7.50 GJ_th / t | Elec: 400-650 kWh_e / t | Net Water: +2.0 t H2O/t
PRIMARY PROVENANCE: Deutz & Bardow (2021) Nature Energy; Climeworks
